population: User-supplied XAUUSD M1/M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 history from 2023-01-03 through 2026-06-19; frozen M7C-style state machine replayed separately per signal timeframe; entries evaluated from first causal M1 turn with historical spread treatment.
evidence_warning: All historical periods are research-exposed. M5/H1/H4 branch conditions below are exploratory and must not be promoted from these historical results. M15 N3 uses the already deterministic M9P canonical result.

S1_M5_STRICT_MULTI_TIMEFRAME_LONG.definition: M5 first-turn LONG where the M5 adaptive own-timeframe core is true (M5 tick-volume-ratio20 <= trailing-200 median OR M5 MACD(6,13) line bps >= trailing-200 75th percentile), AND latest fully closed M15 MACD line bps >= trailing-100 75th percentile, AND latest fully closed H1 MACD line bps >= trailing-100 median, AND latest fully closed H1 RCI9 >= trailing-100 median.

S2_M15_CANONICAL_N3.definition: Canonical strict-full-window M15 N3 = N1 quiet M5 pullback OR N2 strong M15 MACD momentum, as frozen in M9O/M9P.

S3_H1_HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_MOMENTUM_LONG.definition: H1 first-turn LONG where latest fully closed H4 MACD(6,13) line bps >= its trailing-100 75th percentile AND latest fully closed D1 MACD line bps >= its trailing-100 median.

S4_H4_DAILY_TREND_LONG.definition: H4 first-turn LONG where latest fully closed D1 RCI9 >= its trailing-100 median AND D1 EMA20 > EMA30 > EMA40.
S4_H4_DAILY_TREND_LONG.warning: Very small yearly samples, especially 2023 and 2026. Aggregate PF is not trustworthy as a live expectation.

frequency_and_overlap.warning: Do not sum branch counts as independent trades. Multiple timeframes can describe the same market move and should be deduplicated/used as confidence stacking.

portfolio_direction: Stop requiring every single branch to preserve high monthly frequency. Let portfolio breadth across timeframes/tickers supply frequency.
Use stricter quality filters per timeframe, then deduplicate overlapping LONG events rather than opening one position per timeframe.
When multiple timeframes agree, treat agreement as confidence/quality information first, not automatic pyramiding.
Keep M15 N3/Q1/Q2/Q3 risk-reward work as one branch, not the whole system.
Do not force GOLD SHORT until a stable branch exists.
BTC remains a separate research family. No 2023-2026 BTC historical dataset is currently available; continue genuine-source/M7C/M8C forward collection and do not transplant GOLD rules into BTC.
